name: APU coursework materials (user-labeled Semesters 1–5)
source_label: Extracted candidate from five user-provided assignment materials in data/materials/, ordered as the user-labeled Semesters 1–5. The Semester 1 visual programming brief identifies itself as Diploma coursework; the sequence is user-provided and is not an officially verified programme specification.

modules.name: Introduction to Visual and Interactive Programming
outcomes: Apply computational thinking to solve a problem
Use visual interactive programming tools to develop an application
modules.assignment: Group project: create an interactive SNAP! application from one of two case studies; game applications are excluded.

modules.name: Database Management
outcomes: Apply redundancy control in designing a database
Demonstrate a database solution using an appropriate tool based on a case study
modules.assignment: Design, implement and document an E-Library Management System database, including schema, ERD, normalization and SQL queries.

modules.name: Programming with Python
outcomes: Build a Python software solution for a business case with distinct functional areas
Organize customer, user and inventory management into separately maintained areas
modules.assignment: Group assignment: implement a computer sales and repair transaction system with customer, user and inventory management.

modules.name: Responsive Web Design and Development
outcomes: Explain internet infrastructure and web page development
Develop a responsive website using client-side scripting and HCI principles for multiple user clients
modules.assignment: Build a responsive web application for online assessment activities using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP and MySQL.

modules.name: Capstone Project
outcomes: Design, develop, test and implement an extensive application
Develop teamwork and coordination competency within a set period
Present a software development project professionally
modules.assignment: Fourteen-week group software project spanning proposal, development, documentation and presentation deliverables.
